method.direction: Left baseline, right new conditional account; difference is candidate minus baseline.
method.matching: Unique actual entry date; matched execution entry prices are asserted identical.
method.cash_cycles: Actual buy outlay and net sale proceeds plus actual residual cash reconstruct each wealth cycle. Product equals actual terminal NAV.
method.open: Mark actual remaining quantity at the same closing price used in the account; no hypothetical sale fee.
method.windows: ALL through 2026-10-15; WITHOUT2026 truly truncates at 2025-12-31 and marks then-open positions at that closing NAV.
method.years: Entry-year cohorts for path decomposition; separate natural-year NAV statistics. Cohort contributions are not annual account profit.
method.interpretation: Matched+left-only+right-only log terms add to actual log NAV difference. Position percentages do not add to account return. Cash-lot effects can have either sign.
method.causality: Historical attribution, not independent causal effects. Position duration changes later entry availability; residual cash depends on prior path.
method.bridge: Original H3 paired diagnostic kept all original entries. Actual conditional account cannot necessarily take those entries. Matched actual exit and paired prediction verified for every both-closed original entry.
method.examples: Largest absolute log differences selected only to explain realized episodes; no retrospective deletion or new strategy.
